title: GraveSafe
description: Death chest graves with owner lock, XP return and expiry cleanup.
body:
# GraveSafe

Overview
GraveSafe stores death drops in a chest at the death location with owner-only access and optional expiry cleanup.

Highlights
- Creates a chest grave with the player's items.
- Owner-only access, with admin bypass permission.
- XP stored and returned on first open.
- Automatic cleanup after configurable expiry time.

Commands
- /gravesafe [status|list|reload]

Permissions
- gravesafe.use
- gravesafe.admin

Config
- expire-minutes, search-radius, cleanup-interval-seconds, chest-name

Tags
graves, death-chest, keep-inventory, pve, survival, utility

Compatibility
Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
Game versions: 1.16.5 - 1.21.1
